note: Reviewed findings of the Reports tab (Research Conclusions Atlas). Each finding cites the master cell it comes from (report id, column, exact excerpt) and, when checked, the page of the public original with a short phrase found there. Checked against originals downloaded on 2026-11-24 (RPT-013 read on 2026-11-26; a report may give its own check date); originals are not stored in Git.

reports.title: What robotics companies look like, and what they’re betting on
reports.format: Interactive web study with a Markdown report
reports.scope: An independent study of 652 robot companies in 44 countries: their robots, brands and words, the money behind them (912 funding rounds of 411 venture-backed companies) and the AI models they release. Covers robots of all kinds, with humanoids and robot AI as one group.

reports.title: Physical AI, part 2: Humanoid robots
reports.short: Bank of America · Physical AI part 2
reports.scope: An eight-page explainer by the Bank of America Institute. Its forecasts (shipments, population, bill of materials) are BofA Global Research's; the 2027 sector split is Counterpoint Research's.

reports.title: The Humanoid 100: Mapping the Humanoid Robot Value Chain
reports.published_note: As extracted; not yet checked against the original
reports.host_note: Hosted on a Morgan Stanley adviser page
reports.scope: Equity research listing 100 public companies across the humanoid value chain, with US and China market models (as extracted).

check.note: The original could not be opened from the review environment (the server closed the connection). Its findings are shown as extracted and are not plotted.

reports.title: AI Gets Physical (Impact Series 14)
reports.scope: A thematic report on humanoid robots and physical AI, with a market model in low, base and high cases built from AlphaSense sources (PDF p.17).

reports.title: The Robotics Readiness Gap
reports.published_note: Month not stated; PDF dated August 2026 (as extracted)
reports.scope: An opinion survey of 800 senior leaders in organisations with revenue of at least US$500 million in Germany, Japan, South Korea and China, about robotics broadly (as extracted).

check.note: The publisher's page refused the review environment (HTTP 403). Its findings are shown as extracted and are not plotted.

reports.title: What work can robots do?
reports.short: Anthropic · What work can robots do?
reports.format: Web article with a PDF version
reports.scope: Builds a task-level index of which US work tasks robots could perform, scoring about 19,000 O*NET tasks with Claude and cited robot sources, and compares job exposure with historical wage and employment data and with robot costs. Covers robots in general, not only humanoids.

reports.title: Humanoid Robotics & Physical AI
reports.scope: Part I of a sector series. It makes no market forecast of its own: it compares other publishers' forecasts, noting they answer different questions, and models cost per productive robot-hour.

reports.title: Physical AI – the rise of the machines
reports.short: RBC BlueBay · Rise of the machines
reports.scope: A seven-page investor note. Most of its figures cite BofA Global Research, McKinsey and Morgan Stanley; it repeats them rather than adding new estimates.

reports.title: Physical AI: Taking human-robot collaboration to the next level
reports.host_note: The PDF is hosted by MEO; the publisher is Capgemini Research Institute.
reports.scope: A survey of 1,678 executives across 15 industries (January–February 2026) plus expert interviews, about physical AI in robotics broadly, with a chapter on humanoids.

reports.title: 2026 Humanoid Robot Study
reports.scope: A market analysis of about 90 commercial humanoid vendors and a survey of 152 industry participants about deploying embodied AI (humanoids).

reports.title: The Future of Humanoid Robots (1st Edition)
reports.short: Berg Insight · Future of Humanoid Robots
reports.authors: Martin Apelgren, Emilia Rickard and Julia Wahlén
reports.format: Public 6-page summary of a 160-page paid report
reports.restrictions: Only the public summary was reviewed; the paid report and its models were not seen.
reports.scope: A strategy report with 15-year forecasts of shipments, installed base and market value. Only the public summary is available.

reports.title: Global Automation: Humanoid Robot: The AI accelerant
reports.restrictions: Many exhibits are redacted in the public edition.
reports.scope: Equity research raising Goldman Sachs' humanoid forecasts in January 2024. Its figures are forecasts made in that edition, not later outcomes.

reports.title: The Robot Frontier Is Accelerating
reports.short: Playground · The Robot Frontier Is Accelerating
reports.scope: A research post built on the publisher's own Robot Intelligence Index (25 benchmarks of robot policies, in simulation and on real robots, as of 23 November 2026): how fast the leading policies improve, how many tasks they solve, at what time and cost, and two conditional projections to the end of 2027. The ratings are the publisher's own and not independently verified.
